en: Black-and-white postcard view of a narrow harbor lined with wooden houses and boathouses on both sides. Several masted fishing boats are moored along the rocky shoreline and piers. The perspective looks inward along the calm waterway toward the distant mouth of the harbor. Text in the lower left labels the location, and a small triangular publisher's logo with a number appears in the lower right.
